text.en: Today, only aim to be a little better than yesterday's version of you.
text.vi: Hôm nay bạn chỉ cần tốt hơn phiên bản của chính mình hôm qua.

text.en: A small honest start can pull a whole day into motion.
text.vi: Một khởi đầu nhỏ và chân thành có thể kéo cả ngày chuyển động theo nó.

text.en: Give the next useful action more attention than the perfect plan.
text.vi: Hãy chú tâm vào hành động hữu ích tiếp theo, thay vì mải mê với kế hoạch hoàn hảo.

text.en: Your energy often arrives after you invite it with movement.
text.vi: Năng lượng thường chỉ đến sau khi bạn chủ động bắt tay vào làm.

text.en: Make progress visible enough that tomorrow wants to continue it.
text.vi: Hãy để tiến bộ hôm nay đủ rõ ràng, để ngày mai muốn tiếp tục nó.

text.en: The day changes direction when you do one thing on purpose.
Momentum is built from ordinary choices repeated without drama.
Use the hour you have; waiting for a better hour spends two.
Let the first step be imperfect, but let it be real.
A willing effort is already a vote for the person you are becoming.
Turn anticipation into action before doubt learns your schedule.
You do not need a louder dream; you need a nearer next move.
Show up early enough for possibility to recognize you.
The work begins where the excuse stops being interesting.
Collect beginnings, because finished things are made from them.
Let curiosity carry you through the doorway that confidence has not reached.
When your purpose feels distant, make the next task smaller rather than the dream smaller.
An unfinished task is not a verdict; it is an invitation waiting for a return visit.
You can restart a difficult afternoon with one clean decision and a little patience.
Each time you choose effort over avoidance, you teach your future self that progress is available.
Discipline is keeping small promises to yourself, even when no one is watching.
text.vi: Kỷ luật là giữ lời hứa nhỏ với chính mình, ngay cả khi không ai nhìn thấy.

text.en: A routine becomes powerful when it survives an unremarkable day.
text.vi: Một thói quen trở nên mạnh mẽ khi nó vẫn tồn tại qua những ngày bình thường nhất.

text.en: Choose the useful repeat over the exciting exception.
text.vi: Hãy chọn sự lặp lại có ích, thay vì một ngoại lệ hấp dẫn nhất thời.

text.en: Make the right action easier to begin than the distraction.
text.vi: Hãy làm cho hành động đúng đắn dễ bắt đầu hơn là sự xao nhãng.

text.en: Consistency is a quiet skill that gets stronger every time you use it.
text.vi: Sự kiên trì là một kỹ năng thầm lặng, càng dùng nó càng trở nên mạnh mẽ.

text.en: Protect the habits that protect your attention.
Do the planned work before evaluating whether you feel like it.
Your calendar reveals which intentions received a real address.
Finish the simple obligation before inventing a more interesting one.
Boundaries are commitments with a door and a lock.
Prepare tonight for the decision you want to make tomorrow.
The system matters most on the days when inspiration is absent.
A delayed reward still counts when the work is done with care.
Reduce the number of decisions between you and the important work.
Honor the process long enough for its results to become visible.
Discipline is not harshness; it is giving your priorities dependable protection.
A missed day asks for a calm return, not a dramatic apology.
Build a life where the helpful choice is ready before the tempting choice appears.
When the task feels heavy, keep the agreement and lighten the pace.
The strongest routine is not the one that looks impressive from outside; it is the one you still keep on a tired day.
One task done in stillness is often clearer than ten done in a rush.
text.vi: Một việc được làm trong tĩnh lặng thường rõ ràng hơn mười việc làm vội vàng.

text.en: Attention grows where you stop scattering it.
text.vi: Sự tập trung lớn lên ở nơi bạn ngừng phân tán nó.

text.en: Close the extra doors so the chosen door can open fully.
text.vi: Hãy đóng những cánh cửa thừa, để cánh cửa bạn chọn mở ra trọn vẹn.

text.en: Protect the next thirty minutes from unnecessary opinions.
text.vi: Hãy bảo vệ ba mươi phút tiếp theo khỏi những ý kiến không cần thiết.

text.en: The priority is the work you return to after every interruption.
text.vi: Ưu tiên chính là việc bạn quay lại làm sau mỗi lần bị gián đoạn.

text.en: Make your environment vote for concentration.
One finished priority outweighs a crowded list of intentions.
Name the task precisely enough that your mind cannot wander around it.
Clarity appears when you stop asking every task to happen at once.
Let the important work have the freshest part of your attention.
A notification is a request, not an instruction.
Concentration begins with deciding what will wait.
Return gently to the page, the problem, or the practice in front of you.
Your best work needs fewer tabs and more patience.
Protect a small block of deep effort like a meeting with your future.
Do not confuse being reachable with being useful.
The mind settles when the next action is visible and the rest is allowed to wait.
Choose a single meaningful target, then let repetition make it familiar.
A clear desk cannot do the work for you, but it can stop arguing with your attention.
Attention is the only currency that buys depth. Spend it on one thing long enough to see past the surface.
Confidence grows from every time you keep your word to yourself.
text.vi: Sự tự tin lớn lên từ những lần bạn giữ đúng lời hứa với chính mình.

text.en: You are allowed to learn in public and improve in private.
text.vi: Bạn được phép học hỏi trước mọi người và âm thầm tiến bộ.

text.en: Speak to yourself with the patience you offer a determined beginner.
text.vi: Hãy nói với bản thân bằng sự kiên nhẫn bạn dành cho một người mới bắt đầu đầy quyết tâm.

text.en: Capability is often quieter than the fear that questions it.
text.vi: Năng lực thường lặng lẽ hơn nỗi sợ đang nghi ngờ nó.

text.en: Let preparation carry more weight than self-doubt.
text.vi: Hãy để sự chuẩn bị kỹ lưỡng nặng ký hơn sự nghi ngờ bản thân.

text.en: You can be uncertain and still be ready for the next step.
A mistake can revise your method without reducing your worth.
Your voice becomes steadier each time you use it honestly.
Do not wait to feel complete before contributing something useful.
Practice makes room for courage to enter the conversation.
You know more than yesterday because you stayed present for today.
A calm question can be stronger than a rushed answer.
Claim your progress without needing to make it louder than anyone else’s.
Your next attempt deserves the benefit of what the last attempt taught.
Show your work the respect of believing it can get better.
Confidence is built by meeting a hard moment and noticing that you remained yourself.
You do not need universal approval to make a thoughtful decision.
Let competence be assembled one honest repetition at a time.
The room may be unfamiliar, but your ability to listen, learn, and respond still belongs there.
Confidence is the memory of having survived the last hard thing. Collect those memories on purpose.
Real growth comes from the lessons you stay with long enough to fully understand.
text.vi: Trưởng thành thực sự đến từ những bài học bạn chịu ở lại để hiểu hết.

text.en: A better question can change the direction of an entire effort.
text.vi: Một câu hỏi hay hơn có thể thay đổi cả hướng đi của một nỗ lực.

text.en: Let feedback become information before it becomes identity.
text.vi: Hãy để phản hồi trở thành thông tin, trước khi nó trở thành cái tôi.

text.en: The beginner’s version of you deserves a fair chance to practice.
text.vi: Phiên bản mới bắt đầu của bạn xứng đáng có cơ hội để luyện tập.

text.en: Growth often feels ordinary while it is happening.
text.vi: Sự trưởng thành thường trông rất bình thường khi nó đang diễn ra.

text.en: Keep a record of lessons so difficulty can become reusable wisdom.
Try a new method long enough to understand its language.
The gap between skill and ambition is a place to train, not hide.
Improvement begins when comparison becomes curiosity.
Keep revising the approach instead of repeating the disappointment.
A new skill rewards the person who can stay teachable through awkwardness.
Be patient with the part of progress that cannot be rushed into being visible.
Your future range expands every time you practice beyond familiar results.
Failure can become useful when you ask it a specific question.
Keep the humility to change and the courage to continue.
The person you want to become is shaped by what you are willing to study.
A rough first draft is a map of where your understanding can improve.
Every useful correction shortens the distance between intention and skill.
Keep choosing the version of practice that teaches you something new.
Growth asks you to trade the comfort of already knowing for the richer discomfort of discovering.
Lasting success starts with small commitments you keep in full.
text.vi: Thành công bền vững bắt đầu từ những cam kết nhỏ mà bạn giữ trọn.

text.en: A meaningful result usually begins as a modest commitment.
text.vi: Một kết quả ý nghĩa thường bắt đầu từ một cam kết khiêm tốn.

text.en: Build outcomes from actions you can repeat with integrity.
text.vi: Hãy xây dựng kết quả từ những hành động bạn có thể lặp lại một cách chính trực.

text.en: Let your standards guide the work after applause has left the room.
text.vi: Hãy để tiêu chuẩn của bạn dẫn dắt công việc, ngay cả khi tiếng vỗ tay đã tắt.

text.en: Celebrate the milestone, then make space for the next careful step.
text.vi: Hãy ăn mừng cột mốc, rồi dành chỗ cho bước đi cẩn trọng tiếp theo.

text.en: Results improve when your effort has a direction and a measure.
A useful finish is better than an admired intention.
Choose goals that make your days more deliberate, not merely busier.
Measure the work by the value it creates, not only by the hours it consumes.
Good results often look like a thousand small decisions made with care.
Keep your ambition connected to the people and problems it can serve.
Finish what matters before chasing the next proof that you are capable.
A strong outcome is built twice: once in preparation and once in follow-through.
Make room to notice how far steady work has already carried you.
Let each achievement improve your responsibility, not just your résumé.
Success becomes sustainable when it leaves enough strength for the next season.
Do not borrow urgency from someone else’s scoreboard.
The most useful victory is one that enlarges what you can contribute tomorrow.
Aim for work you can respect when the result is no longer new.
Success is more durable when it includes the way you arrived: the habits you kept and the people you did not spend.
